image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a circular aneroid barometer mounted on a light blue wall. The instrument features a polished chrome or silver metal casing with a glass cover. The dial face is white/cream with black numerical markings and a decorative central illustration of a landscape (mountains/trees). Two black pointer hands are visible. To the left, a small portion of a brass object (possibly part of a lamp or another fixture) is visible.

The two hands seem to emerge from a slightly undefined central point. The layering of which hand is on top is ambiguous, and the pivot mechanism lacks mechanical precision.
